personality_one_liner: A highly readable, operation-focused utility that frames content without dominating it, letting status and data take priority.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable vertical padding. Use md/lg margins around grouped content. No half-width orphans in cards.

navigation: bottom_tabs with stack overlays and side drawer for role-management navigation

do_s: Use for sticky bottom tabs, sticky header backgrounds, and bottom-sheet handles.
Ensure text on glass is fully readable by adding a tinted layer underneath.
dont_s: Do not apply to standard cards, form inputs, or body content regions.

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: Role-based authentication entry point for franchisees and company staff.

states.error: Toast or inline text above login button with readable message.

screens.layout: Centered form (Single column) with logo on top. Inputs with labels above. Primary action button sticky or well above the keyboard (KeyboardAvoidingView). Brand color prominently featured on the button.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide immediate overview of store checks, urgent announcements, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and announcements
states.empty: Illustration for 'No Urgent Announcements' or 'All clear'
states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen flex.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying welcome message. Quick-action cards in a 2-column grid or single-column stack below. Expandable Announcements list taking bottom half. 'Urgent' tagged items highlighted with error/warning semantic tokens.

screens.name: Store Checks List
screens.purpose: A searchable, filterable list of all store checks displaying their review status.

states.empty: Red clipboard icon + 'No store checks yet' + 'Create New Check' button.
states.error: Error loading checks message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with segmented controls (Awaiting, Approved, Returned). List items with a minimum 56pt height containing title, metadata (date), and a status badge on the right. FAB (Floating Action Button) with glass effect for creating new checks.

screens.name: Store Check Form
screens.purpose: Execution of a store check with temp readings, checklists, and shift open/close.

states.error: Inline validation text explaining specific missing fields.

screens.layout: Long scrolling single-column form. Real-time validation. Labels above inputs. Number inputs for temperature readings. Sticky primary 'Submit' CTA at the bottom above safe area. 'Open/Close Shift' segmented toggle prominently at the top.

screens.name: Account Management
screens.purpose: Role-based admin view to add, edit, and remove staff/managers/franchisees.

states.empty: Icon + 'No accounts added yet' + 'Add Account' CTA.

screens.layout: List view of accounts categorized by role (Tabs or Segmented Control). Bottom sheets used for 'Add/Edit Account' flows rather than separate screens.

screens.name: Store Check Template Management
screens.purpose: Edit template structure, store custom layouts, and create new check types.
screens.layout: List of templates with 'Edit' action leading to a detailed form view. Reorderable list UI for checklist items.

screens.name: Account Settings
screens.purpose: Personal details and password modification screen.
screens.layout: Standard single-column form with grouped fields. Logout button at the bottom.

empty_state_clipboard.alt: Empty clipboard for checklist empty state

bubba_pizza_logo.alt: Neon pizza signage representing the brand

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color tokens for Light and Dark modes. The app supports auto-switching based on system preference.
Max font weight allowed is 500. Use Figtree for all text elements. Let size carry the hierarchy, not the weight.
Absolutely NO BLUE allowed. The info token has been set to a neutral gray/slate (#525252/#a3a3a3).
Use real-time inline validation for forms. Do not rely solely on submission-only errors.
Place labels above inputs for all form fields, and use proper keyboard types (e.g., numeric for temperatures).
Implement bottom sheets for editing or creating entities (like Add Account) to preserve context.
Store Checks form needs a sticky 'Submit' CTA at the bottom outside the scroll view, ensuring it clears the safe area.
Status colors (success/error/warning) must strictly map to Approved/Returned/Urgent states.
Ensure all text overlays on images have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
